curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a stubborn miser truly change his ways before the season passes him by?
curatedMovie.description: Blinded by greed, Ebenezer Scrooge rejects the spirit of Christmas until newfound visitors arrive to guide him toward kindness in this animated retelling of the classic Dickens story starring iconic Disney characters.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, thoughtful, and comfortably paced for an easy family-friendly holiday viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: At a breezy twenty-five minutes, Burny Mattinson's animated adaptation pairs timeless holiday sentiment with beloved classic characters for a gentle, family-friendly watch.
